title: Step IV:  Repeat the Previous Steps Until All Vertices Have Been Visited

blocks.content: Step IV:  Repeat the Previous Steps Until All Vertices Have Been Visited
Since E is the only vertex with an indegree zero, we add E to the topological sort list and remove it along with its outgoing edges.

blocks.alt: Add Vertex E to the List and Remove it From the Graph

blocks.content: Now, we repeat the process for the next vertex with indegree 0.

blocks.alt: Remove Vertex A and Then Vertex C From the Graph

blocks.content: The same process continues until we have no vertices to process.

blocks.alt: Add Vertex D to the List and Remove it From the Graph
